verses.en: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
verses.sm: SA latou nonofo i tausaga e tolu22 ua leai se taua ia Suria ma Isaraelu.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le tausaga e tolu, ona alu ifo lea o Iosefatu le tupu o Iuta, i le tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is our's, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
verses.sm: Ua fai atu le tupu o Isaraelu i ana auauna, Tou te le iloa ea o RamotaKiliata o la tatou aai lea, a ua tatou nofonofo ua le faoa mai le lima o le tupu o Suria.

verses.en: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi o ia ia Iosefatu, Ta te o atu ea ma a‘u i le taua i Ramota- Kiliata? Ona fai mai lea o Iosefatu i le tupu o Isaraelu, O a‘u nei e pei o oe lava, o lo‘u nuu e pei o lou nuu, o a‘u solofanua e pei o au lava solofanua.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai foi Iosefatu i le tupu o Isaraelu, Se‘i e fesili i le aso nei i se afioga mai ia Ieova.

verses.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto mai lea e le tupu o Isaraelu o le au perofeta, pe toafa selau o tagata, ma na fai atu ia te i latou, Ou te alu atu ea i Ramota-Kiliata e tau ai le taua, pe ou te nofo ? Ona latou fai mai lea, Ia e maliu ae; auā e foaiina mai ai e le Alii i le aao o le tupu.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Iosefatu, E le o iinei ea ma se perofeta a Ieova, ina ia tatou fesili atu ia te ia ?

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu o Isaraelu ia Iosefatu, O le tasi tagata foi o Mekaio, o le atalii o Imila, tatou te fesili atu ai ia Ieova; a ou te ‘ino‘ino ia te ia, auā na te le vavalo mai ia te au i mea lelei, a o mea leaga. Ona fai mai lea o Iosefatu, Aua le fetalai faapea mai le tupu.

verses.en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.
verses.sm: Ona valaau lea o le tupu o Isaraelu i le tasi auauna sili, ua faapea atu, Ia e faavave mai ia Mekaio le atalii o Imila.

verses.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.sm: Ua taitasi ma nofo i lona nofoālii, o le tupu o Isaraelu, ma Iosefatu le tupu o Iuta ; sa oofu foi i laua i o laua ofualii, i le mea e aunoa e lata ane i le faitotoa o Samaria; o loo vavalo foi perofeta uma i o la luma.

verses.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.
verses.sm: Na faia foi e Setekaia, le atalii o Kenaana o nifo uamea mo ia, ma fai atu, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o IeoVa, O mea nei e te suatia 4i Suria, seia e faaumatia i latou.

verses.en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king's hand.
verses.sm: Ua faapea foi ona vavalo o perofeta uma, ua faapea atu, Ina maliu ae ia i Ramota-Kiliata, ma ia manuia; auā e foaiina mai ai e Ieova i le aao o le tupu.

verses.en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.
verses.sm: O le auauna na alu e aami ia Mekaio, ua fai atu o ia ia te ia, ua faapea atu, Faauta mai ea i upu a le au perofeta i le tupu, ua tasi, ua lelei; se‘i faapea foi lau upu, ia pei o le upu a so latou, ia e fai atu se upu lelei.

verses.en: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Mekaio, O loo soifua Ieova, o le mea e fai mai ai Ieova ia te au, o le mea lea ou te fai atu ai.

verses.en: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.sm: Ua sau foi o ia i le tupu. Ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia te ia, Mekaio e, pe matou te o atu ea i Ramota- Kiliata i le taua, pe matou te nonofo ? Ona fai mai lea o ia ia te ia, Ina maliu ae ia, ma ia manuia; auā e foaiina ihai ai e Ieova i le aao o le tupu.

verses.en: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the LORD?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia te ia, Pe foi faafia ea ona ou fai atu ia tauto oe; aua ne‘i e fai mai ia te au se mea e tasi, tau lava o le upu moni i le suafa o Ieova?

verses.en: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o ia, Na ou iloa atu ia Isaraelu uma ua faataapeapeina i mauga, e pei o mamoe ua leai so latou leoleo. Ona fetalai mai lea o Ieova, Ua leai so latou alii; ia latou taitasi ma toe foi atu i lona fale ma le filemu.

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu o Isaraelu ia Iosefatu. Na ou le fai atu ea ia te oe, na te le vāvalo mai ia te au se mea lelei, na o le mea leaga?

verses.en: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o Mekaio, O lenei, ia e faafogafoga mai i le afioga a Ieova. Na ou iloa atu ia Ieova o loo tietie i lona nofoālii; sa tutū foi ‘au uma a le lagi e latalata ia te iā, i lona itu taumatau ma lona itu tauagavale.

verses.en: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
verses.sm: Na fetalai atu foi Ieova, Po o ai ea na te faaoleole ia Aapo, ina ia alu ae o ia, ma oti i Pamota-Kiliata ? Ona fai mai lea o le tasi e faapea, a e fai mai le isi e faapea.

verses.en: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.
verses.sm: Ona alu ane lea o le tasi agaga, ma tu mai i luma o ieova, ua fai mai, Ou te faaoleole ia te ia.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
verses.sm: Na fetalai atu foi Ieova ia te ia, I ni a ea ? Ona fai mai lea o ia, Ou te alu, ma ou fai ma agaga pepelo i fetalai atu lea o Ieova, E te faaoleole ia te ia, e te malo foi; ina alu ia, ina e faia ia o lea.

verses.en: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.
verses.sm: O lenei, faauta, ua tuuina e Ieova le agaga pepelo i gutu o au perofeta nei uma; auā ua fetalai e Ieova ia oo le leaga ia te oe.

verses.en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
verses.sm: Ona faalatalata mai lea o Setekaia le atalii o Kenaana, ma na tu‘i mai ia Mekaio i lona alafau, ma fai mai, Po o fea na ui ai le Agaga o Ieova nai ia te au e tautala atu ia te oe ?

verses.en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Mekaio, Faauta, e te iloa i lea lava aso e te alu atu ai i le afeafe tuloto e te lafi ai.

verses.en: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o le tupu o Isaraelu, Ina ave ia ia Mekaio, ma toe ta‘ita‘i ia te ia ia Amone le alii o le aai, ma Ioasa le atalii o le tupu;

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
verses.sm: ma e fai atu, O loo o faapea mai le tupu, Ina tuuina atu ia o lenei tamaloa i le falepuipui, ma fafaga ia te ia i le mea e ‘ai a e ua tigaina, ma le vai a e ua tigaina, seia ou sau ma le manuia,

verses.en: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Mekaio, Afai lava e te toe maliu mai ma le manuia, ua ou le tautala i le afioga mai ia Ieova. Ua fai ane foi o ia, Ina faalogologo mai ia o outou le nuu uma.

verses.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.sm: Ona o ae lea o le tupu o Isaraelu, ma Iosefatu le tupu o Iuta i RamotaKiliata.

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu le tupu o Isaraelu ia Iosefatu, Ou te ofu ese a‘u, ma alu i le taua; a ia e ofu oe i lou lava ofu. Ona ofu lea o le tupu o Isaraelu i ofu ese ma alu i le taua.

verses.en: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu le tupu o Suria i alii e toatolugafulu ma le toalua e pule i ona kariota, ua ia faapea atu, Aua ne‘i tou tau ma se tagata nuu po o se alii, tau lava o le tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu e alii e pule i kariota ia Iosefatu, ona latou faapea ane lea, Ai o le tupu o Isaraelu lena. Ona latou faasaga ane lea, latou te tau ma ia ; ona alaga lea o Iosefatu.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e alii e pule i kariota, e le o le tupu o Isaraelu lea, ona latou foi atu lea, ua le toe tuliloa ia te ia.

verses.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.sm: Ua soona fana e le tasi tagata lana u, ua lavea ai le tupu o Isaraelu i le soo o lona ofutau uamea. Ona fai atu lea o ia i le ta‘ita‘i o lona kariota, Ina liliu ane ia o lou lima, ma ave ia te au i tua o ‘au, auā ua ou manua.

verses.en: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
verses.sm: Na faatetele le taua i lea lona kariota e faafeagai ma Suria; ona oti lea o ia i le afiafi; ua sisina ifo le toto o le manua i totonu o le kariota.

verses.en: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
verses.sm: Ua alu le manu i le goto o le la i ‘au, ua faapea, Ia taitasi ma alu i lana aai ma lona nuu.

verses.en: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.sm: Ua oti foi le tupu, ua au mai i Samaria; ua latou tanu foi le tupu i Samaria.

verses.en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.
verses.sm: Ua fufulu e se tasi le kariota i le vailepa i Samaria, ua latou fufulu foi lana auupega ; na etoeto foi e ul lona toto, e tusa ma le afioga a Ieova na ia fetalaia mai.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.sm: O toe o mea na faia e Aapo, ma mea uma na ia faia, ma le fale nifo o elefane na ia faia, ma aai uma na ia faia, ua le tusia ea i le tusi o tala i nofoaiga a tupu o Isaraelu ?

verses.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.sm: Ua taoto Aapo faatasi ma ona tamā, ona soloai ane lea o Aasaia lona atalii e fai ma tupu.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.sm: O le fa o tausaga o Aapo le tupu o Isaraelu na fai ai Iosefatu le atalii o Asa ma tupu o Iuta.

verses.en: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.sm: E tolu sefulu ma le lima o tausaga o Iosefatu ina o fai o ia ma tupu ; na fai foi o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema i tausaga e lua sefulu ma le lima; o Asopa le igoa o iona tinā, o le afafine o Seleki.

verses.en: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
verses.sm: Na savali o ia i ala uma o Asa lona tamā, ua le alu ese ai o ia, na faia e ia o mea tonu i luma o Ieova; a ua le aveeseina o mea maualuluga; ua fai taulaga pea le nuu, ma faamuina mea manogi i mea maualuluga.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.sm: Na lelei Iosefatu ma le tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.sm: O toe o mea na faia e Iosefatu, ma iona fitafita sa fai, ma ona taua, ua le tusia ea ia i le tusi o tala i nofoaiga a tupu o Iuta ?

verses.en: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
verses.sm: O tagata faasotoma na totoe, o e na totoe i ona po o Asa lona tamā, na aveesea e ia ai le nuu.

verses.en: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
verses.sm: Sa leai se tupu i Etoma; na fai ma tupu le na tofia e pule.

verses.en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.
verses.sm: Na fai vaa Tasesa e Iosefatu e ō i Ofeira e maua ai auro; a ua le oo, ina ua tu£ia o vaa i Esiokape.

verses.en: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Aasaia le atalii o Aapo ia Iosefatu, Ia o faatasi a‘u auauna ma au auauna i vaa; a ua le mafai Iosefatu.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.sm: Ua taoto Iosefatu faatasi ma ona tamā, ua tanumia foi o ia faatasi ma ona tamā i le aai a lona tamā o Tavita; ona soloai ane lea o Iorama lona atalii e fai ma tupu.

verses.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
verses.sm: O le sefulu ma le fitu o tausaga o Iosefatu le tupu o Iuta na fai ai Aasaia le atalii o Aapo ma tupu o Isaraelu i Samaria; e lua tausaga na fai ai o ia ma tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
verses.sm: Ua amio leaga foi o ia i luma o Ieova, ua ia savali i le ala o lona tamā, ma le ala o lona tinā, ma le ala o Ierepoamo le atalii o Nepata, o le na faatupuina le agasala ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.
verses.sm: Auā na ia auauna ia Paala, ma ifo atu ia te ia, ma nā faaonoono ia Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu, e tusa ma mea uma na faia e onu tamā.
